verdict.rationale: NotebookLM generates summaries, insights, mind maps, briefing documents, AI-suggested report types, and answers with grounded citations directly from uploaded sources, and community feedback confirms real-world use for research insight extraction (e.g., audio overviews, code walkthroughs). Missing for 10: independent benchmarking of insight quality/accuracy and evidence of more proactive/agentic suggestion behavior beyond user-initiated Q&A.
